answer: TotalEnergies reports Scope 3 Category 11 (use of sold products) for its value chain, excluding biogenic CO2, at 335 MtCO2e in 2025. To avoid understating the two hydrocarbon chains, it uses the larger activity volume: product sales for oil because sales exceed production, and marketable gas and condensate production for gas because production exceeds gas sales. The value is therefore a Category 11 boundary measure, not all Scope 3 categories, and the oil and gas activity bases are deliberately different.

normalized_value.selection_rule: largest volume in each oil and gas value chain
normalized_value.caution: not a total of all Scope 3 categories and oil/gas use different activity bases

evidence.quote: GHG emissions - Scope 3 ... Value chain, excluding biogenic CO2, GHG Protocol – category 11.
the calculation ... for the oil value chain considers products sales (higher than production) and for the gas value chain, the marketable gas and condensates production (higher than gas sales)
